edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). Each party may disclose non-public information to the other in connection with the Purpose (“Confidential Information”). Confidential Information includes information identified as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it using at least reasonable care. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its representatives who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those herein, and shall be responsible for their breaches. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving party can demonstrate is publicly available without breach, was lawfully known without restriction before disclosure, is lawfully received from a third party without restriction, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. Disclosure required by law is permitted, provided the receiving party, to the extent legally permitted, gives prompt notice and reasonably cooperates in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the receiving party shall return or destroy Confidential Information, except copies required by law or retained in routine backups, which remain subject to this Agreement.

3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. The confidentiality and use restrictions survive for three years after each disclosure; provided that protection of trade secrets continues for so long as they qualify as trade secrets under applicable law.

4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages may be inadequate. The disclosing party may seek injunctive relief, subject to applicable law, in addition to other available remedies. Neither party is obligated to proceed with any transaction.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). Each party may disclose non-public information to the other in connection with the Purpose (“Confidential Information”). Confidential Information includes information disclosed before, on, or after the effective date of this Agreement in connection with the Purpose and information identified as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure.
edits.name: Purpose and pre-execution disclosures

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it using at least reasonable care. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its representatives who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those herein, and shall be responsible for their breaches. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving party can demonstrate is publicly available without breach, was lawfully known without restriction before disclosure, is lawfully received from a third party without restriction, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. Upon becoming aware of any unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information, the receiving party shall promptly notify the disclosing party and provide reasonable assistance in mitigating its effects and preventing further unauthorized use or disclosure. Disclosure required by law is permitted only to the extent legally required, provided the receiving party, to the extent legally permitted, gives prompt notice and reasonably cooperates in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information and, if requested, certify such return or destruction in writing through an authorized representative. The receiving party may retain copies required by law or retained in routine backups, provided such copies are inaccessible for ordinary business use and remain subject to the continuing confidentiality and use restrictions of this Agreement for the applicable periods under Section 3. Any certification shall identify the categories of copies retained under this exception and confirm compliance with these retention restrictions.
edits.name: Confidentiality, incident response, compelled disclosure, and disposition

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. Its confidentiality and use restrictions apply from the effective date to Confidential Information disclosed before that date and apply to subsequent disclosures when made. Those restrictions continue for five years after each disclosure, notwithstanding expiration or termination of this Agreement; provided that, for Confidential Information qualifying as trade secrets under applicable law, the confidentiality and use restrictions continue for so long as that information qualifies as trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: Five-year restrictions and continuing trade-secret protection
